description: Error-category coverage for the owner/repository extraction when the remote address does not match the recognized SSH shorthand contract. Exercises a remote pointing at a non-matching host, an address that lacks the required separating slash between owner and name, an address carrying more path segments than the canonical owner/name pair, and an address written with an unsupported URL scheme. The input is a single URL string and the output reports the modeled error category together with the offending URL.
